sentences.en: The President decided to provide developing countries with sufficient aid.
sentences.zh: 总统决定向发展中国家提供足够的援助。

sentences.en: A country without enough labour force cannot be self sufficient.
sentences.zh: 没有足够的人力资源，一个国家无法实现自给自足。

sentences.en: Without sufficient atmospheric pressure, body fluids will start to boil.
sentences.zh: 如果没有足够的大气压力，体内的液体将会开始沸腾。
